newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.

text.p: Good harvesting weather promoted active corn and sorghum harvest in Nebraska during the week ended Sunday, according to the latest crop report from the state's Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn was 86 pecent harvested. That figure compared with 87 percent last year and the five-year average of 80 percent.
Sorghum grain harvest was 80 percent complete, well behind 100 percent last year and also behind the average pace of 92 percent, the report said.
The winter wheat crop was rated 74 percent good to excellent, 24 percent fair and two percent poor.
Topsoil moisture was rated three percent very short 26 percent short, 69 percent adequate and two percent surplus.
